The 2026 tax return for ESTATE OF HELEN MARIE has been successfully received by the Canada Revenue
        Agency and will be processed once the supporting document(s) is received.

Please visit the Submitting and filing documents online related to T3 website to
        see the procedure to submit the supporting documents.

The same selection criteria for verifying a trust return is used for both paper
        and electronic versions.

Your client needs to keep all trust information slips and documents for six
        years after you filed the tax return.
